set_span: In the five Phase 3 studies of DOACs for acute treatment of patients with a DVT, with or without pulmonary embolism (PE), participants randomized to receive a DOAC did not differ from those receiving warfarin on the odds of recurrent VTE and related death (the primary outcome in most studies of secondary prevention in acute VTE), but this primary outcome showed a tendency to favor DOACs (OR 0.88, CI 0.75–1.03).
